$meta.policy: Brand path geometry is kept unchanged inside a SoduWork-owned container. Recorded brand colors are applied in the local SVG asset; container styling may distinguish the runtime, but must not crop, redraw, or add elements to a third-party mark.
$meta.fallbacks: Unknown runtimes retain the generic shield. Codex and Codex Harness use the local reference-based knot mark recorded below; it is not presented as an official OpenAI asset.
$meta.reviewEvidence: Sources were checked against the recorded official source or brand-guideline URL before inclusion. SHA-256 values pin the exact local files.
